---
id: "smk-18"
title: "AFC Ajax"
---

AFC Ajax is a professional football club from Amsterdam, the capital of the Netherlands. Founded in 1900, the club has won the Dutch league championship more often than any other team and has also won the KNVB Cup many times. Ajax is best known abroad for its European successes in the early 1970s, when a team built around Johan Cruyff won three consecutive European Cups playing a style that became known as total football, and for a fourth European title, the Champions League of 1995. The club plays its home matches at the Johan Cruyff Arena, a stadium with a retractable roof that opened in 1996. The Ajax youth academy has a reputation for developing technically skilled players who are later sold to larger clubs across Europe. The club's rivalry with Feyenoord of Rotterdam is the most heated in Dutch football.
